q1: SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM (SELECT NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) AS T
q2: WITH SINGLE AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(DISTINCT NUM) THEN NUM ELSE NULL END NUM FROM MYNUMBERS GROUP BY NUM HAVING COUNT(NUM) = 1) SELECT MAX(NUM) AS NUM FROM SINGLE
